Portronics Apollo 20 Portable Speaker – Powerful 25W Bluetooth Speaker with Wireless Karaoke Mic

The Portronics Apollo 20 Portable Speaker is designed for music lovers who want deep bass, loud output, and wireless convenience in one compact device. This 25W Bluetooth Speaker delivers immersive sound performance powered by a dual passive radiator, making it ideal for home entertainment, outdoor parties, travel, and karaoke sessions.

Built with modern audio technology, the Portronics Apollo 20 Portable Speaker ensures distortion-free sound even at high volumes. Whether you are hosting a small gathering or enjoying solo music time, this speaker offers rich lows, clear mids, and balanced highs. The elegant black finish adds a premium touch while blending effortlessly with any décor.

25W High-Output Bluetooth Speaker with Dual Passive Radiator

Experience room-filling audio with this engineered for powerful sound delivery. The integrated dual passive radiator enhances bass response, providing punchy low frequencies without compromising clarity. From Bollywood beats to EDM and podcasts, every sound feels more dynamic and engaging. The advanced Bluetooth connectivity ensures quick pairing with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and smart TVs. Enjoy seamless wireless music streaming with stable signal strength and minimal latency.

Wireless Karaoke Mic for Ultimate Entertainment

Turn any moment into a fun-filled karaoke session with the included wireless karaoke mic. The mic pairs effortlessly with the speaker, making it perfect for family events, parties, kids’ performances, or practice sessions. This feature makes the more than just a speaker—it’s a complete entertainment solution.

Up to 5 Hours Playtime with Type C Fast Charging

Enjoy uninterrupted music with up to 5 hours playtime on a single charge. The long-lasting battery ensures consistent performance whether indoors or outdoors. With Type C charging, the speaker supports faster and more efficient charging, keeping downtime to a minimum. The portable design allows you to carry the speaker easily, making it suitable for travel, picnics, road trips, and outdoor use. Lightweight yet durable, it is built to perform wherever you go.

Key Features

  • Powerful 25W Bluetooth Speaker for loud and clear sound output
  • Dual Passive Radiator for enhanced bass and richer audio experience
  • Wireless Karaoke Mic included for fun and interactive entertainment
  • Up to 5 Hours Playtime for extended music sessions
  • Type C Charging for faster and reliable power delivery
  • Portable and Compact Design ideal for home and outdoor use
  • Premium Black Color with modern and stylish aesthetics
  • Bluetooth Wireless Connectivity with wide device compatibility

Why Choose?

If you are looking for a reliable portable Bluetooth speaker with powerful sound and added karaoke functionality, the stands out as an excellent choice. It combines performance, portability, and entertainment in a single device, making it suitable for both personal and professional use. Ideal for music streaming, voice amplification, karaoke, and casual gatherings, this speaker delivers great value for money. With trusted build quality and modern features, it is designed to meet everyday audio needs effortlessly.

Perfect for Home, Parties & Outdoor Use

Its strong battery backup, enhanced bass, and wireless connectivity make it a versatile choice for all age groups.
